title: proc-posets: a poset, cospan and string-diagram core for process mining
description:
Reusable poset / cospan / string-diagram calculation, simulation, estimation and comparison core for process-mining research. It provides the canonical modular (block) decomposition of a labelled poset, a stochastic matrix distance and its known-law estimators, and screens that ask of a log whether it carries within-case concurrency or loops at all.

The core is stdlib-only and installs at Python 3.10; the numpy, graph, pm4py and plotting layers sit behind extras. Every extraction seam is locked by an in-repo regression suite that reproduces the originating code value-for-value.
